opportunities.name: Health Kingslayer return
opportunities.objective: Use bonus health to support a second low-health W rather than a single burst.
opportunities.mechanic: W healing includes AP and a bonus-health Stat term, doubling toward low health. Riftmaker turns bonus health into AP and Visage increases received healing; Cosmic helps stay close and Dusk rewards attacks between casts. E access and charge attacks are still necessary to maintain contact.
opportunities.requiredState: W targets a champion, current health recorded and enough time for a second W.
opportunities.failure: Grievous Wounds or burst before the second cast defeats the sustain budget.
opportunities.test: Measure W heal at above and below 40% health with matched bonus health, then record second-cast access.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Kingslayer's champion heal does not apply identically against minions.

opportunities.name: Petricite AD ratio
opportunities.objective: Test AD on the passive's main-target magic attack conversion.
opportunities.mechanic: Petricite Burst converts a main-target attack using 1.3 AD and 0.3 AP, while charged state gives 125% attack speed. Trinity, Titanic and Bloodmail test a health/AD attack budget; Abyssal supports nearby passive magic damage while Titanic supplies separate physical packets. Hijacked R selection remains opponent dependent.
opportunities.requiredState: Cast then spend passive charges instead of overflowing the charge cap, with finite bonus health.
opportunities.failure: Losing AP weakens W/Q/E and converted magic attacks gain nothing from armor penetration.
opportunities.test: Separate main-target passive magic damage, splash and item physical damage after one cast at matched total AD.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Passive's magic conversion does not prove it carries every ordinary attack or crit rule.

ruledOut.reason: Hijack requires an enemy ultimate and applies a per-enemy cooldown with a minimum duration.

unknowns: Petricite item/crit inheritance, W health Stat flag and stolen ultimate conversion depend on live logs and the chosen enemy.

builds.goal: Use bonus health to support a second low-health W rather than a single burst.

Riftmaker turns bonus health into AP and Visage increases received healing; Cosmic helps stay close and Dusk rewards attacks between casts. E access and charge attacks are still necessary to maintain contact.
testPlan: Required state: W targets a champion, current health recorded and enough time for a second W.
Measure W heal at above and below 40% health with matched bonus health, then record second-cast access.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Grievous Wounds or burst before the second cast defeats the sustain budget.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Kingslayer's champion heal does not apply identically against minions.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Riftmaker, Spirit Visage, Cosmic Drive, Dusk and Dawn, Rabadon's Deathcap, Mercury's Treads. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

kitEvidence.formula:
After using an Ability, Sylas gains a charge (max [rankTable[2, 3, 3, 3, 3, 3, 3]] charges). Sylas' Attacks expend a charge to whirl his chains, dealing [(1.3) × AD + (0.3) × AP] magic damage to the main target and [(0.4) × AD + (0.2) × AP] magic damage to other surrounding enemies.

While he has at least one charge, Sylas gains [125]% Attack Speed.

Sylas lunges at an enemy with magical force dealing [75 / 110 / 145 / 180 / 215 + (0.6) × AP] magic damage. Against champions, Sylas restores between [20 / 40 / 60 / 80 / 100 + (0.3) × AP + (0.05) × Stat(12)[statFormula=2]] and [(20 / 40 / 60 / 80 / 100 + (0.3) × AP + (0.05) × Stat(12)[statFormula=2]) × (2)] Health based on his missing Health (max healing at or below [40]% Health).

Sylas quickly dashes, and prepares a Recast for 3.5 seconds.

Recast: Sylas throws his chains, pulling himself to the first enemy hit, dealing [80 / 130 / 180 / 230 / 280 + (0.8) × AP] magic damage, and Knocking Up for [0.5] seconds.
